description: This file contains functions and classes for managing General Ledger (GL) entries, including creation, validation, merging, reversing, and rounding off entries within the ERPNext accounting system.

classes.name: ClosedAccountingPeriod
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to closed accounting periods.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Main function to create or reverse GL entries based on provided map and flags.

methods.name: validate_accounting_period
methods.description: Checks if the transaction date falls within an open accounting period.

methods.name: process_gl_map
methods.description: Processes and merges GL entries, toggling debit/credit for negative values, and updates net values.

methods.name: update_net_values
methods.description: Adjusts debit and credit values to reflect net amounts when post_net_value is set.

methods.name: merge_similar_entries
methods.description: Merges GL entries with similar account and dimensions to optimize ledger entries.

methods.name: check_if_in_list
methods.description: Checks if a GL entry with matching account and dimensions exists in a list.

methods.name: save_entries
methods.description: Validates, rounds off, and saves GL entries to the database.

methods.name: make_entry
methods.description: Creates and submits a single GL Entry document.

methods.name: validate_cwip_accounts
methods.description: Ensures CWIP accounts are not used in non-Journal Entry transactions.

methods.name: round_off_debit_credit
methods.description: Ensures debit and credit totals are balanced within allowed tolerance, applying rounding if necessary.

methods.name: make_round_off_gle
methods.description: Creates a rounding adjustment GL entry to balance debits and credits.

methods.name: get_round_off_account_and_cost_center
methods.description: Retrieves the configured round-off account and cost center for a company.

methods.name: make_reverse_gl_entries
methods.description: Generates reversing GL entries by swapping debit and credit for a given voucher.

methods.name: check_freezing_date
methods.description: Prevents posting of entries before the frozen date unless authorized.

methods.name: set_as_cancel
methods.description: Marks original GL entries as canceled for a specific voucher.
